snippet.title: Qix: Xonix Casual Edition Gameplay  #QixXonixCasualEdition
snippet.description:
Special thanks to HapGames for providing me game copy - Kaan

Remake of a classic old-school hit from 80s, one of the first arcade games ever!

It used to be super popular in its time and today we went further and added an extra dimension for more action – meet Qix!

Modern 3D graphics in addition to classic, time proven gameplay will redefine your gaming experience!

We all have played a variation of this retro game when we were kids - old-school fans should remember that 8-bit action - now it's a completely new 3D game with outstanding graphics and smooth intuitive controls!

#gameplay #walkthrough

Welcome to my channel. I am Kaan! My aim is to convey the games to you from my own view without comment. When you watch my channel, I provide you with the best quality gameplay and walkthrough videos. Most of the games are provided by the game companies. My main goal is that you can watch my gaming videos just like a movie and to help you where you are stuck. I spend hours every day on video editing, constantly improving my gameplays, but if you have any suggestions, please leave them in the comments!

Sub the channel: https://www.youtube.com/kaanboğa/?sub_confirmation=1
Follow me on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/anokvaburada/
